title: Historical-research to modern palindrome bridge contract
objective: Transfer validated generation principles from the historical 31-kana research layer into the modern 怪文回文 generator without publishing historical diction or weakening current Japanese-quality gates.

bridge_principles.rule: Validate only boundaries/factors actually moved by an operation; unchanged host context keeps its source-local analysis.
Do not maximize combinatorics. Narrow candidate pools by scene before semantic-role review.
A replacement must preserve the host segment's discourse/semantic job, not merely share vocabulary or part of speech.
A<-B and B<-A are separate judgments.
Held and rejected combinations remain regression fixtures.
Generated candidates retain structural, morphology, scene, semantic-role, and source/provenance traces.

modern_targets.reason: Already decomposes candidates into core and ordered shells with boundary-shift and particle-hinge metadata.
Narrative families already carry dimensions/stages and can adopt scene/role compatibility when choosing extensions or wrappers.
Productive rules are already grammar-curated; research gates can later help combine rules into longer coherent structures.

public_candidate_adapter.rule: Research trace remains in data/test artifacts. Public candidate gets a concise human-readable why string and only whitelisted quality metadata.

research_operation_may_inform_public_gen: at least one positive candidate and one negative/control candidate exist
operation has explicit scene and semantic-role gates

currently_qualified_as_rule_sources.note: Qualified as a generation principle, not for publishing historical outputs.
Qualified as a generation principle with trusted positive/control pair.
Qualified as a constrained-center substitution principle.

historical_content_policy.reason: The public app is a modern 怪文回文 maker; historical corpus is evidence for generation architecture, not a content feed.

plan: Inspect existing cores/shells/recipes for repeated shell corridors.
Assign scene and semantic-role metadata only where current display/recipe evidence supports it.
Generate candidate substitutions in a research script, never directly in index.html.
Require strict palindrome, shell alignment validity, scene compatibility and semantic-role compatibility.
Freeze positive and negative controls before UI exposure.

public_integration_sequence: public adapter data with explicit whitelist
add separate pool function to index.html
only then consider a new button or inclusion in DNA pool
non_goals: Publishing historical waka as modern generator output
LLM runtime generation in the browser
Increasing candidate count without coherence gates
Changing public UI before research prototype passes regression
